name: CSS 342 – Data Structures, Algorithms, and Discrete Mathematics I
description: First course in UWB's data structures and algorithms sequence. Covers linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, and introductory algorithm analysis using C++. Foundational for technical interview performance at software engineering firms.
registration_info: Enroll via UWB SDB registration. Check prerequisite (CSS 143 or equivalent).
notes: Offered most quarters. Confirm current offerings on MyPlan.

name: CSS 343 – Data Structures, Algorithms, and Discrete Mathematics II
description: Continuation of CSS 342. Covers balanced BSTs, heaps, hash tables, graphs, graph algorithms, and advanced sorting. One of the highest-value courses for passing technical interviews at software engineering firms.
registration_info: Prerequisite: CSS 342.
notes: Offered most quarters. Confirm on MyPlan.

name: CSS 370 – Technical Writing for Computing and Software Systems
description: Technical communication course for computing students. Covers specification writing, API documentation, technical reports, and professional communication. Directly applicable to software engineering documentation, technical program management, and developer relations roles.
registration_info: Prerequisite: English composition. Check SDB for current prerequisite details.
notes: Verify course number and title in current UWB catalog.

name: CSS 422 – Hardware and Computer Organization
description: Architecture of modern computers including CPU design, memory hierarchy, instruction sets, and I/O systems. Foundational for embedded systems, firmware, systems programming, and hardware-adjacent software engineering.
registration_info: Check prerequisites on MyPlan.
notes: Confirm offering schedule; may be offered once per year.

name: CSS 430 – Operating Systems
description: Covers processes, threads, scheduling, memory management, file systems, and synchronization primitives. Highly relevant for backend infrastructure, cloud systems, embedded software, and systems engineering roles.
registration_info: Prerequisite: CSS 422 or equivalent.
notes: Verify prerequisite chain on MyPlan.

name: CSS 432 – Network Programming
description: TCP/IP networking, socket programming, client-server architecture, and network protocol implementation. Provides hands-on experience building networked applications in C/C++. Relevant for backend, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure roles.
registration_info: Prerequisite: CSS 430.
notes: Verify prerequisite on MyPlan.

name: CSS 436 – Cloud Computing
description: Hands-on cloud computing course covering AWS or equivalent, distributed systems concepts, serverless computing, containers, and scalable application design. Direct preparation for cloud engineering, DevOps, and backend SWE roles.
registration_info: Check prerequisites on MyPlan.
notes: Verify offering schedule and whether AWS credits are provided.

name: CSS 440 – Software Engineering Project
description: Capstone software engineering course involving team-based development of a full-stack application from requirements gathering through delivery. Covers Agile practices, CI/CD, code review, and professional engineering workflows. Strong resume signal demonstrating end-to-end project ownership.
registration_info: Prerequisite: CSS 480.
notes: Verify prerequisite on MyPlan. Projects are typically showcased at end-of-year event.

name: CSS 452 – Programming Languages
description: Survey of programming language design including syntax, semantics, type systems, functional programming, and language implementation. Broadens language fluency relevant to compiler, interpreter, and language tooling roles.
registration_info: Check prerequisites on MyPlan.
notes: Verify offering schedule; may be offered once per year.

name: CSS 471 – Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
description: Introductory AI course covering search algorithms, constraint satisfaction, probabilistic reasoning, and machine learning fundamentals. Provides conceptual grounding for AI engineering, data science, and ML-adjacent software roles.
registration_info: Check prerequisites on MyPlan.
notes: Verify offering schedule.

name: CSS 475 – Computer Networking
description: In-depth study of computer network protocols, the OSI model, TCP/IP stack, routing algorithms, and network security fundamentals. Relevant for network engineering, cloud infrastructure, and backend systems roles.
registration_info: Check prerequisites on MyPlan.
notes: Verify offering schedule and confirm it is distinct from CSS 432.

name: CSS 480 – Introduction to Software Engineering
description: Covers the software development lifecycle, requirements engineering, design patterns, testing methodologies, and team development practices. Foundation course for the CSS capstone and directly applicable to industry software engineering roles.
registration_info: Prerequisite: CSS 343. Verify on MyPlan.
notes: Typically required before CSS 440 (capstone).

name: CSS 484 – Database Management Systems
description: Relational database design, SQL, normalization, transactions, indexing, and query optimization. Essential for backend software engineering, data engineering, and full-stack development roles.
registration_info: Check prerequisites on MyPlan.
notes: Verify offering schedule.

name: CSS 487 – Machine Learning
description: Practical machine learning course covering supervised learning, unsupervised learning, neural networks, model evaluation, and ML engineering practices using Python. Strong resume credential for ML engineering, data science, and AI product roles.
registration_info: Check prerequisites (CSS 343 and linear algebra recommended). Verify on MyPlan.
notes: Verify offering schedule.

name: CSS 490 – Special Topics in Computing
description: Variable-topic advanced course. Past topics include web development, open-source software engineering, applied AI, and security. Skills earned vary by topic. Check the current quarter's MyPlan listing for the active topic.
registration_info: Check current quarter's SDB/MyPlan for available sections and topics.
notes: Topic changes each quarter. Must re-verify skills and description each time a new section is added.

name: CSS 499 – Directed Research
description: Independent research course supervised by a CSS faculty member. Students propose and complete a research project in a computing subdomain. Produces a faculty reference and a research artifact — two of the strongest differentiators in competitive internship and graduate school applications.
registration_info: Contact a CSS faculty member directly to propose a project before registering.
notes: Requires faculty sponsorship. Confirm current faculty research areas on the CSS department website.

name: UW Undergraduate Research Program (URP)
description: UW-wide program connecting undergraduates with paid or for-credit research positions across all departments. CSS students can apply for computing and data science research roles with UW Seattle and UWB faculty.
registration_info: Applications accepted on a rolling basis; check URP site for current open positions.
notes: Verify the URP site is current and that UWB students are explicitly eligible.

name: UWB STARS – Summer Teaching and Research Scholars
description: Competitive summer program at UW Bothell pairing undergraduates with faculty mentors for an intensive research project. Participants present findings at the end-of-summer symposium. Strong credential for graduate school applications and research-oriented industry roles.

notes: Verify program is active for the upcoming summer and confirm application deadline.

name: UW Reality Lab (XRML)

name: CSS Faculty Research Labs at UWB

cost: academic credit or paid (depends on faculty funding)
registration_info: Email faculty directly with a brief research interest statement and transcript.
notes: Verify current faculty research areas and which faculty are actively accepting undergraduates.
